No class-diagram skill was available, so I built this by reading the 24 production classes under `src/main/java` and leaving out the tests.

```mermaid
classDiagram
    direction TB

    %% ===== model =====
    class BaseEntity {
        <<MappedSuperclass>>
        -Integer id
        +getId() Integer
        +setId(Integer id)
        +isNew() boolean
    }
    class NamedEntity {
        <<MappedSuperclass>>
        -String name
        +getName() String
        +setName(String name)
        +toString() String
    }
    class Person {
        <<MappedSuperclass>>
        -String firstName
        -String lastName
        +getFirstName() String
        +setFirstName(String)
        +getLastName() String
        +setLastName(String)
    }

    %% ===== owner =====
    class Owner {
        <<Entity>>
        -String address
        -String city
        -String telephone
        -List~Pet~ pets
        +getPets() List~Pet~
        +addPet(Pet pet)
        +getPet(String name) Pet
        +getPet(Integer id) Pet
        +getPet(String name, boolean ignoreNew) Pet
        +addVisit(Integer petId, Visit visit)
    }
    class Pet {
        <<Entity>>
        -LocalDate birthDate
        -PetType type
        -Set~Visit~ visits
        +getType() PetType
        +setType(PetType type)
        +getVisits() Collection~Visit~
        +addVisit(Visit visit)
    }
    class PetType {
        <<Entity>>
    }
    class Visit {
        <<Entity>>
        -LocalDate date
        -String description
        +getDate() LocalDate
        +getDescription() String
    }
    class OwnerRepository {
        <<interface>>
        +findByLastNameStartingWith(String lastName, Pageable p) Page~Owner~
        +findById(Integer id) Optional~Owner~
    }
    class PetTypeRepository {
        <<interface>>
        +findPetTypes() List~PetType~
    }
    class OwnerController {
        <<Controller>>
        -OwnerRepository owners
        +findOwner(Integer ownerId) Owner
        +processCreationForm(Owner, BindingResult, RedirectAttributes) String
        +processFindForm(int page, Owner, BindingResult, Model, RedirectAttributes) String
        +processUpdateOwnerForm(Owner, BindingResult, int, RedirectAttributes) String
        +showOwner(int ownerId) ModelAndView
    }
    class PetController {
        <<Controller>>
        -OwnerRepository owners
        -PetTypeRepository types
        +populatePetTypes() Collection~PetType~
        +findOwner(int ownerId) Owner
        +findPet(int ownerId, Integer petId) Pet
        +initPetBinder(WebDataBinder)
        +processCreationForm(Owner, Pet, BindingResult, RedirectAttributes) String
        +processUpdateForm(Owner, Pet, BindingResult, RedirectAttributes) String
    }
    class VisitController {
        <<Controller>>
        -OwnerRepository owners
        +loadPetWithVisit(int ownerId, int petId, Map model) Visit
        +processNewVisitForm(Owner, int petId, Visit, BindingResult, RedirectAttributes) String
    }
    class PetValidator {
        <<Validator>>
        +validate(Object obj, Errors errors)
        +supports(Class clazz) boolean
    }
    class PetTypeFormatter {
        <<Formatter~PetType~>>
        -PetTypeRepository types
        +print(PetType, Locale) String
        +parse(String, Locale) PetType
    }

    %% ===== vet =====
    class Vet {
        <<Entity>>
        -Set~Specialty~ specialties
        +getSpecialties() List~Specialty~
        +getNrOfSpecialties() int
        +addSpecialty(Specialty specialty)
    }
    class Specialty {
        <<Entity>>
    }
    class Vets {
        <<XmlRootElement>>
        -List~Vet~ vets
        +getVetList() List~Vet~
    }
    class VetRepository {
        <<interface>>
        +findAll() Collection~Vet~
        +findAll(Pageable) Page~Vet~
    }
    class VetController {
        <<Controller>>
        -VetRepository vetRepository
        +showVetList(int page, Model, RedirectAttributes) String
        +showResourcesVetList() Vets
    }

    %% ===== system =====
    class WebConfiguration {
        <<Configuration>>
        +localeResolver() LocaleResolver
        +localeChangeInterceptor() LocaleChangeInterceptor
        +addInterceptors(InterceptorRegistry)
    }
    class CacheConfiguration {
        <<Configuration>>
        +petclinicCacheConfigurationCustomizer() JCacheManagerCustomizer
    }
    class WelcomeController {
        <<Controller>>
        +welcome() String
    }
    class CrashController {
        <<Controller>>
        +triggerException() String
    }

    %% ===== root =====
    class PetClinicApplication {
        <<SpringBootApplication>>
        +main(String[] args)$
    }
    class PetClinicRuntimeHints {
        <<RuntimeHintsRegistrar>>
        +registerHints(RuntimeHints, ClassLoader)
    }

    %% ----- inheritance -----
    BaseEntity <|-- NamedEntity
    BaseEntity <|-- Person
    BaseEntity <|-- Visit
    Person <|-- Owner
    Person <|-- Vet
    NamedEntity <|-- Pet
    NamedEntity <|-- PetType
    NamedEntity <|-- Specialty

    %% ----- domain associations -----
    Owner "1" *-- "0..*" Pet : pets
    Pet "1" *-- "0..*" Visit : visits
    Pet "0..*" --> "1" PetType : type
    Vet "0..*" --> "0..*" Specialty : specialties
    Vets o-- "0..*" Vet : vets

    %% ----- repositories -----
    OwnerRepository ..> Owner : manages
    PetTypeRepository ..> PetType : manages
    VetRepository ..> Vet : manages

    %% ----- controllers / services -----
    OwnerController --> OwnerRepository
    PetController --> OwnerRepository
    PetController --> PetTypeRepository
    PetController ..> PetValidator : creates
    VisitController --> OwnerRepository
    VetController --> VetRepository
    VetController ..> Vets : creates
    PetTypeFormatter --> PetTypeRepository
    PetTypeFormatter ..> PetType : formats/parses
    PetValidator ..> Pet : validates

    %% ----- bootstrap -----
    PetClinicApplication ..> PetClinicRuntimeHints : imports
    PetClinicRuntimeHints ..> BaseEntity : registers
    PetClinicRuntimeHints ..> Person : registers
    PetClinicRuntimeHints ..> Vet : registers
```
